title: A promenade plaque proof
passage: Check your promenade plaque layout at the proof desk. The top faces the street. The dashed border on the drawing shows where the plaque meets the pavement; it won't appear on the plaque. To change a person's title, use a correction slip. Keep the dedication date: it marks the promenade opening, not your order. We don't print here; once you approve the proof, we'll mail your paper copy.
passageZh: 請到校樣服務台查看步道紀念牌的版面。版面頂端朝向街道。圖上的虛線邊框表示紀念牌與鋪面的交界；成品上不會有這條線。修改人物頭銜請填更正單。紀念日期不要更動，它指的是步道啟用日，不是下單日。服務台不列印；核准校樣後，我們會寄出紙本副本。
